name: Nikaidou Rei
source: She is the lead singer in the nationally acclaimed idol group, Zettai Zetsumei Panda, and her nickname is Nikarei. After having expanded her career into acting, her stardom has skyrocketed, with a recent casting in the lead role of a movie. She is visiting Mihate Town for the summer while a movie is being filmed there.
